name: read-pdf-documents
description: Cheapest-first PDF reading over routed x402: extract page-delimited Markdown and metadata from a public PDF URL, then use OCR only for scanned or image-only documents.

pdfUrl.description: Public HTTPS PDF URL. Must not contain credentials or resolve to a private/local network address.

title.description: Short document title used in the Markdown extraction output (maximum 200 characters).
